newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kerry Prop details US$250 mln bond terms.
newsitem.headline: Kerry Prop details US$250 mln bond terms.

text.p: Kerry Properties Ltd said it had finalised the terms of a wholly-owned unit's US$250 million two-percent convertible guaranteed bond issue due June 15, 2007.
Kerry Properties will unconditionally and irrecovably guarantee the bonds to be issued at par, it said in a statement published in newspapers on Wednesday.

They will be convertible into Kerry's shares at an initial conversion price of HK$21.50 each, representing a 18.13 percent premium on their Tuesday closing price of HK$18.20. But the conversion price is subject to adjustment, the statement said.

The joint global co-ordinators, Merrill Lynch Far East Ltd, J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd and Morgan Stanley & Co International Ltd, have an option to require the issuer to issue up to a further US$50 million of such bonds.

Assuming US$300 million bonds are taken up with full conversion, Kerry will issue 108.10 million new shares, representing about 10.58 percent of its existing issued share capital and 9.57 percent of the enlarged issued share capital.
That will generate expected net proceeds of about US$243.75 million before expenses but after management and underwriting commission and selling concession, Kerry said.
It intends to use the proceeds mainly to finance property development and investment operations, and for general corporate purposes. They will be invested in short-term interest-bearing investments.

The bonds, expected to be issued by Kerry Properties Capital Ltd on March 25, are being offered to institutional and professional investors internationally. The issue has been arranged and lead managed by the joint global co-ordinators.

Application has been made for the listing of the bonds on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, while application is also being made to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong for the listing of and permission to deal in the shares to be issued resulting from the bond offer.
